request.text: I changed my mind about 30 minutes; remind me in 45 minutes to take the laundry out of the washer.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder in 45 minutes to take the laundry out of the washer, using the user's corrected delay rather than the abandoned 30-minute value.

new_goals.description: Have a reminder to remove the laundry from the washer after the corrected delay.
new_goals.source_text: I changed my mind about 30 minutes; remind me in 45 minutes to take the laundry out of the washer.
constraints: Use a 45-minute delay, not the superseded 30-minute value.
success_criteria: The reminder is scheduled for 45 minutes from the request with the requested laundry content.

semantic_facts: The proposed reminder Work should use the final authoritative delay of 45 minutes and the laundry-removal content.
The Planner may resolve the explicit correction while preparing Work, but canonical confirmation is still required before creating the reminder.
forbidden_claims: A reminder has already been set for either 30 or 45 minutes.
The superseded 30-minute value is used, or both delay values become reminder Work.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A superseded temporal value survives into Work because both numbers appear in the admitted text.
Resolving an explicit correction is confused with receiving confirmation to perform the stateful effect.
